subject: PR #1118 — iOS port parity is now behavioural (plan row 18): TS decisions replayed through the Swift port; first replay caught the declared DR-043 drift, ported and closed; review + merge
body: PR #1118 (mac/ios-parity-behavioral @ 7d3d1241) closes plan row 18, the loop's rank-3 task and the only one of its three that needs a Mac. New proof:decision-engine-parity (scripts/src/decision-engine-parity-proof.ts) runs the TS engine over 145 deterministic cases (15 scenarios + 35 triggers alone and on base trust + the removal pair + 11 families pairwise + 3 base shapes) and emits native/shared/decision-engine-vectors.json in the remediation-allow shape; native/ios/EnterpriseShellTests/DecisionEngineParityTests.swift reads it by #filePath and replays every case through DecisionEngine.evaluate asserting ordered outcomes + reason codes; ios-ci.yml now triggers on lib/signalgrid-simulator/**, lib/signalgrid-core/**, native/shared/** and the proof. WHAT IT FOUND: the first replay went red on 6 cases — the Swift port lacked DR-043's unauthorized-removal rule, the TS-only drift DECLARED in check-decision-port-parity.mjs since #748. I ported it into DecisionEngine.swift as a literal transcription of the TS block (the Mac lane repairing the port, per the gate's own header; no new logic) and emptied DECLARED_TRIGGER_DRIFT — the both-ways check is green. The shell emits no dock.device_undocked today, so nothing changes on a device until a producer exists. Measured: proof 14/14; swift test 111/111; xcodebuild EnterpriseShellTests on the iPhone 17 simulator TEST SUCCEEDED; full preflight PASSED (430 ok, 0 failed) and verify:breadth PASSED (58) on the tree before two comment-only edits whose three gates were re-run green after. A three-lens design review (fail-closed / native / gate) traced the same missing rule from source independently before the run hit it; two lenses returned, the third and the synthesis did not complete — said plainly. Ledgers: proof count 154 -> 155 in ZERO_COST_LIVE_TEST_MATRIX, STATUS, LOOP, INVESTOR_ONE_PAGER; two stale sweep exemptions retired to trip-wires; plan row 18 closed with quoted checks. Shared surfaces (rule 2): one appended preflight row + CI step beside remediation-allow; LOOP.md only the proof figure. Also: #1106 landed here — thanks. Open on your side: #1037, #1118.
